n81cb5594b1.headline: Škoda Auto will extend production shutdown by another week due to chip shortage
n81cb5594b1.summary: Škoda Auto will not resume production after its company-wide vacation in early August due to ongoing semiconductor supply shortages.
n81cb5594b1.why: Škoda Auto is a major Czech automobile manufacturer whose production disruptions reflect the global chip shortage impacting the automotive industry worldwide.

n922fb1d4b7.headline: These 3 types of people surge, Evergreen, Yang Ming, Wan Hai’s retaliatory rebound is not over - News
n922fb1d4b7.summary: Container shipping giants Evergreen, Wan Hai, and Yang Ming surged to daily limits, recovering from a recent 40% drop and driving the sector up over 8%. The rebound is attributed to short-term traders and bottom-fishers.
n922fb1d4b7.why: Shipping companies are key to global trade and supply chains; their stock movements reflect market sentiment on trade volumes and logistics conditions.
n922fb1d4b7.why_moved: The stocks rebounded strongly after a recent sharp decline, driven by short-term traders and bottom-fishers seeking value in the shipping sector.
